main.description: Carries a Shout (or another Echo/Murmur) unchanged to a new Place, extending its route across the map. rkey is deterministic from (author DID, parentUri, place id, minute bucket) for the same retry-safety as net.bisks.void.shout.

rootUri.description: The original net.bisks.void.shout this carry-tree started from.

parentUri.description: The shout/echo/murmur this Echo directly carries onward from.
